Privacy Policy

Controller of this website pursuant to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is Paul Werner (contact details: see Imprint).

No Cookies, No Tracking, No Consent Banner

This website sets no cookies, uses no analytics, no tracking pixels, no advertising, no A/B testing, and no fingerprinting of any kind. It stores nothing in your browser's local or session storage.

Every resource this website needs — stylesheets, fonts, images, scripts — is served from this server. No content is loaded from a content delivery network, a font service, or any other third party, so no third party receives your IP address or learns that you visited this site.

There is no consent banner because there is nothing to consent to: no information is stored on or read from your device beyond what is technically required to deliver the pages you request (Sec. 25 (2) no. 2 German Telecommunications Digital Services Data Protection Act – TDDDG).

Server Log Files

When you visit this website, the web server records your IP address, the date and time of access, the name and URL of the retrieved file, the referring website if one was transmitted, the browser used, and, where applicable, your operating system and access provider. This data is processed to deliver the website, to keep it secure and stable, and to diagnose faults. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) f) GDPR — the legitimate interest in operating a functioning and secure website. The data is deleted as soon as it is no longer needed for these purposes. It is not merged with other data and is not used to identify you.

Hosting

This website is hosted on a virtual server operated by Hetzner Online GmbH, Industriestr. 25, 91710 Gunzenhausen, Germany. The server is located in Germany. Hetzner acts as a processor and handles the data described above solely on our instructions, under a data processing agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR. For details, see Hetzner's privacy policy: https://www.hetzner.com/legal/privacy-policy/

Recent Posts on the Home Page

The home page shows a short list of recent blog posts. Your browser fetches that list directly from blog.paulwerner.net, which is our own blog running on the same infrastructure and under the same controller — not a third-party service. That request is subject to the same server log processing described above (Art. 6 (1) f) GDPR). If the request fails, the page simply shows a placeholder; nothing else changes.

Blog (blog.paulwerner.net)

The blog runs on the Ghost publishing software, self-hosted on the same server as this website. No blog content or reader data is sent to Ghost's commercial hosting service or to any other third party, and the blog loads its fonts and scripts from our own server as well.

Ghost sets cookies only where a feature requires them — in particular when a staff member signs in to the administration area, which is not something ordinary visitors encounter. Where a Ghost feature that processes personal data is enabled and you choose to use it (for example subscribing to a newsletter), the data you enter is stored in the database on the same server and used only for that purpose. Reading the blog requires no account and sets no cookies.

Contact via Email

When you contact us via email, your email address and any personal data you include in your message are processed for the purpose of handling your inquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) f) GDPR (legitimate interest) or Art. 6 (1) b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures), depending on the nature of your request. Your data will be deleted once the inquiry has been fully resolved, unless legal retention obligations apply.

Your Rights

As a data subject you have the following rights under Chapter 3 (Art. 12–23) GDPR: right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and the right to object to processing. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). The competent authority is the data protection authority of the German federal state in which you reside, or in which the controller is established.
